customer_jane: Hey team — a couple enterprise customers report OAuth logins failing only on Firefox mobile when they're behind corporate proxies. After GitHub/Google redirect, our token exchange returns 400: "invalid_request: PKCE verifier mismatch". Chrome mobile works fine.

ravi_support: Thanks - can you paste repro steps and a sample (scrubbed) redirect URL? Any request_id from the failed exchanges?

customer_jane: Repro steps (short):
1) Open login on Firefox mobile (both iOS & Android) behind corp proxy.
2) Complete provider auth.
3) Redirect to our /auth/callback with querystring `?code=...&state=...`.
4) Our POST /oauth/token -> 400 pkce_verifier mismatch.

Sample incoming GET we captured at edge (scrubbed):
```
GET /auth/callback?code=CODE123&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVC0tP...== HTTP/1.1
Host: app.customer.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Mobile; rv:116.0) Gecko/116.0 Firefox/116.0
X-Forwarded-For: 10.10.10.5
```

devon_eng: Do our app logs show the exact state value we received server-side? Could it be URL-decoded differently?

ravi_support: Server log for same exchange shows state trimmed: `state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVC0tP... ` (note missing trailing `==` and a space).

sre-bot: Alert: edge rule triggered on cf-edge-3: `url_canonicalize_strip_trailing_equals` for path `/auth/callback` — request id 01ABCD. Rule applied to queries longer than 200 bytes.

maya_platform: That rule was added last month to normalize static asset urls. It shouldn't touch auth callbacks. I'll rollback the rule for `/auth/callback` and push a fix to exclude known auth paths. Rolling back now, ETA ~25m.

devon_eng: Nice catch. Short-term mitigation we can ship: accept PKCE verifier by trying base64url decode with and without padding (i.e., add missing `=` padding) during verification. I'll open a PR for a tolerant decode fallback. More robust fix: don't rely solely on client-side PKCE state if proxies mutate querystrings — fall back to server-stored state cookie/session.

ravi_support: For customer-facing workaround, recommend using a server-side stored state (pre-create state on server and pass short id in query) or have users disable the proxy for SSO flows. Share instructions?

customer_jane: Will relay to customers. Two tenants hit so far (enterprise-acme + megacorp). Do we have timeframe for code change + deploy?

devon_eng: I'll target the tolerant decode change in next patch (hotfix branch) — testing locally now. If tests pass, we can push to prod in ~2-4 hours. Platform rollback completes in ~25m.

maya_platform: Rollback finished on edge-next, verified no more strip_trailing_equals hits for /auth/callback in last 10 min. I'll add path-exclusion and add a unit test to rule config.

ravi_support: Great. I'll mark affected tenants and send a status update + temporary workaround. Please post PR links and deploy IDs here. :thumbsup:

devon_eng: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/auth/compare/fix/pkce-padding-fallback (wip). Will paste deploy id when live.

customer_jane: Thanks everyone — sharing update with customers now. Appreciate the quick response.

sre-bot: Note: created incident INC-2026-153 (edge rule misfire) and linked this thread.

maya_platform: Also flagging security review to ensure rule changes don't open cache bypass vectors.

ravi_support: Closing loop after deploy + customer confirmation. If anyone sees more reports, ping #support immediately.
